key_points: Stock fell ~1.3% on Sep 30, extending recent pullback from highs.
McDonald's is investing $8.5B in AI-driven dynamic pricing (Archy) after an initial setback.
AI pricing rollout has sparked customer controversy over price variation across locations.
Beverage expansion and loyalty program initiatives are cited as potential growth drivers.
Analysts debate whether the current dip presents a buying opportunity amid mixed fundamentals.
